title: Ordinary etale continuity for small cofiltered categories
statement: Let I be a small cofiltered category, D:I → Scheme a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transitions, and c a limiting cone. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves with pullback transitions satisfying the identity and composition laws. Let G:I.op → Sh(c.pt) identify with their pullbacks, compatibly with transitions, and let L be a colimit cocone of G. In any degree r, let H:I.op → Ab identify with H^r(F_i), with arrows specified by cohomology pullback followed by the map of the transition sheaf morphism. A cocone B whose point identifies with H^r(L.pt) and whose legs are the corresponding pullback maps followed by the colimit legs is a colimit cocone. This extends the directed-order continuity theorem [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-of-schemes] to arbitrary small cofiltered categories, without any complexes or differentials.

source.place: Theorem 59.51.3; Tag 0032, directed replacement of a filtered category

proof.text: Choose a nonempty small directed partial order A and a final functor R:A → I.op by IsFiltered.exists_directed (Tag 0032). Its left opposite is initial. Whisker the limiting cone and the colimit sheaf cocone along R; limit and colimit universal properties are preserved. The geometric finiteness hypotheses and affine transitions are inherited. Reindex the scalar sheaves, pullback transitions, and object identifications. R.map_id and R.map_comp, reversal by unop, and proof irrelevance give the two transition coherence equations and compatibility of the pullbacks.

Apply directed-order ordinary etale cohomology continuity to the reindexed scalar sheaves. Compose the cohomology arrow equation on the right with the inverse of its target identification, or cancel the target identification, to obtain the required arrow formula. The supplied leg formula is the whiskered cocone leg formula. This gives a colimit structure on B.whisker R.

Transport the resulting colimit structure back along Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv R B. Cofilteredness excludes an empty category. Zero sheaves and degree zero are included in the same argument.

    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]

    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : j ⟶ i),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id i))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj i)).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j), φ (g ≫ f) =
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g) (D.map f)
        (D.map (g ≫ f)) (D.map_comp g f)).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj (op i) ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app i)).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), G.map f.op = (eG i).hom ≫
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app j) (D.map f)
        (c.π.app i) (c.w f).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app j)).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (r : ℕ)
    (H : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj (op i) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) r))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), H.map f.op ≫ (eH j).hom =
